hero.heading: Where nexusnt.com stands, and what it is worth to fix
hero.intro: Every number here came from a Semrush or Firecrawl pull or from the live HTML of the site. Where a pull was not made, the table says so. This is the baseline the engagement is measured against at 30, 60 and 90 days.
tiles: organic keywords, every one the word nexus or a generic phrase
organic visits a month; 16 of them land on the home page
top-100 rankings for managed it services raleigh (1,000 a month), it support raleigh (720) or it company raleigh (390)
Authority Score, against WorkSmart and Scarlett at 28, Managed IT Solutions 20, Computerbilities 19

findings.title: Absent from every Raleigh managed IT result and every list the lists are made from
findings.evidence: For best managed it services raleigh nc Nexus appears in 0 of 10 results. The results are the lists: Cloudtango, Petronella's top ten for 2026, CloudSecureTech's 19 verified providers with Google review counts, Cortavo's top ten, The Manifest and Clutch. Nexus is on none of them. Managed IT Solutions is 1 for managed it services raleigh with 6,034 visits a month; Scarlett shows a 5.0 rating in the result.
findings.cost: The 1,000-a-month core term plus it support raleigh (720), it company raleigh (390), managed service provider raleigh (320) and it services raleigh nc (260), and every AI answer built from those lists, route to competitors.
findings.fix: A managed IT page titled for Raleigh-Durham with LocalBusiness, Service and FAQPage schema in the build, and profiles on Cloudtango, Clutch, CloudSecureTech and The Manifest in the first 30 days of the plan.

findings.title: The name resolves to the wrong companies
findings.evidence: For nexus network technologies reviews, six of ten results are other companies: Glassdoor's Nexus Technologies (33 reviews), Indeed's Nexus Technology, Trustpilot's Nexus Networks LTD in the UK, G2's Nexus Technologies Inc and AmbitionBox's Nexus Technologies in India. Semrush lists nexus.com.mt, nexusnetworkinternational.com and nexusnetworks.in as the closest competitors. The site's Organization schema carries no address, phone or sameAs, and the WebSite schema still reads Just another WordPress site.
findings.cost: An assistant asked about Nexus in Raleigh has nothing that ties this Nexus to Morrisville, so it answers with someone else's reviews.
findings.fix: Organization schema with legalName, the Morrisville address, phone and sameAs to LinkedIn, Glassdoor and the Google profile; the full name and Raleigh-Durham in every title; one name, address and phone everywhere off-site. In the build.

findings.title: Twenty-two visits a month, none from a service term
findings.evidence: The top keywords are nexus network (210 a month, position 3), site nexus (70) and nexus support number (90); nexus it (390) and nexus technology (390) sit at 43 and 35. The only service terms in the top 100 are av managed services at 67, network services and support at 48 and network security technologies at 55. The home page takes 16 of 22 visits.
findings.cost: Nothing on the site is found by a buyer who does not already know the name.
findings.fix: Twenty-one pages, each built around one thing a Triangle buyer asks, with the place in the title, in the build.

findings.title: The three differentiators have no visibility in their own market
findings.evidence: network as a service provider raleigh: ITSco, Network South, Enitech, Versa and directories, no Nexus, although NaaS is the signature offer. conference room av installation raleigh nc: CTI, Avidex, Insight Tech (4.9 from 149 reviews), no Nexus, although Nexus Collab is a service line. access control installation raleigh nc: FlyLock (4.8 from 117), Network South, Security 101, no Nexus, although the Site Intelligence Platform is access control. Nationally, network as a service (1,600) and naas (1,900) are owned by Cisco, Cloudflare, HPE and Wikipedia.
findings.cost: The services no other Triangle MSP bundles are invisible where a buyer asks for them.
findings.fix: Three pages aimed at the local forms of the terms, each with a definitional FAQ that answers what is network as a service in one sentence. In the build as the networking, meeting spaces and site intelligence pages.

findings.title: No LocalBusiness, FAQPage or Service schema on any of 26 pages
findings.evidence: Every page carries Yoast's Organization and WebSite block and nothing else. Zero LocalBusiness for the Morrisville office, zero FAQPage, zero Service. Scarlett's Raleigh page carries LocalBusiness, GeoCoordinates, OpeningHours, Offer and OfferCatalog; Computerbilities carries ProfessionalService with a postal address. No og:image on any page.
findings.cost: An answer engine cannot tie Nexus to the Triangle, cannot list what it offers and has no question-and-answer text to lift.
findings.fix: Organization plus the Morrisville LocalBusiness on every page, Service schema on every service and industry page, FAQPage on all 21 pages, a branded share image. In the build.

findings.title: No reviews anywhere a buyer looks
findings.evidence: No Google Business Profile appears in any of the six buyer queries. The providers on the lists show 4.6 to 5.0 from 15 to 282 Google reviews (TenPlus 282, ThinkTech 68, XceedIT 67). Nexus has a Glassdoor page for Morrisville with one 5.0 review and a client comments page on the site that comes from post-ticket surveys.
findings.cost: Every list that assistants read is ranked by Google reviews; Nexus is not on the lists because it has no reviews to be ranked by.
findings.fix: Claim the Google Business Profile, and turn the post-ticket survey that already produces the client comments into a Google review request. Review schema on the site only when real reviews exist.

findings.title: The home page title is 93 characters, the description 250, and there is no share image
findings.evidence: Title: Nexus Network Technologies - Service that Surprises You, Security that Won't. IT Matters. The meta description runs to 250 characters. No og:image, so a shared link has no picture. The H1 repeats the tagline. Average title across the site is fine at length, but 23 of 26 titles have no city.
findings.cost: The page carrying 73 percent of traffic says nothing an engine can match to a service or a place.
findings.fix: Retitled to Managed IT, networks, security with Nexus and Raleigh-Durham; a 150-character description; a branded share image; a FAQ on the home page. In the build.

findings.title: Nine of 26 URLs are forms and person pages of 160 to 260 words
findings.evidence: about-mike, about-ronnie, about-shane and about-alt run 159 to 313 words with no H2 and no Person schema; five step-form pages (managed-services-form, consultation-form, av-as-a-service-form, network-as-a-service-form, site-intelligence-platform-form) run 217 to 262 words. All nine score F.
findings.cost: A third of the site is thin pages that dilute the rest and say nothing to a crawler.
findings.fix: One team section on the about page with Person schema, one contact flow, and permanent redirects from the nine URLs. In the build and the redirect map.

findings.title: No blog, no guide, no question answered
findings.evidence: The sitemap holds 26 pages and zero posts; the one article is a 2023 PDF for brokers. Question terms with volume: what is managed it services (1,000), how much does managed it services cost (720), what is access control (1,000), what is network as a service (260). Seven pages have a question-form heading; none has FAQ schema.
findings.cost: AI Overviews and chat answers about managed IT in the Triangle quote Petronella's and Cortavo's guides.
findings.fix: FAQPage on every page of the build, a FAQ page for the buyer's questions, and two guides a month against the question keywords in the 90-day plan.

findings.title: Cary and Durham, the towns around the office, have no page
findings.evidence: it services cary nc: CMIT Solutions of Cary, Mindcore Cary, Net Friends Cary, WingSwept Cary, Petronella Cary. managed it services durham nc: ITSco, Cortavo, TeamLogic IT Durham, Sterling, Mindcore Durham. Nexus in Morrisville sits between the two and has one location page inside the contact section.
findings.cost: The two closest markets have a page from every competitor and none from the company that is actually there.
findings.fix: The location page with LocalBusiness, hours and the 75-mile service ring in the build; Cary, Durham, Raleigh and Chapel Hill service-area pages in days 60 to 90.

findings.title: Authority 7, with chambers the only real links
findings.evidence: 180 referring domains and 316 backlinks. The strongest are Triangle East Chamber (25 links), Charlotte Area Chamber (18) and Greensboro's chamber (7) through GrowthZone, then a run of link shorteners and scrapers (bye.fyi, shortenurls.eu, metamagic.top). Competitors: WorkSmart 28 and 819 domains, Scarlett 28 and 902, Computerbilities 19 and 561, Managed IT Solutions 20 and 256.
findings.cost: The lowest authority in the set, and nothing from a vendor, a client or a directory.
findings.fix: Directory profiles (Cloudtango, Clutch, CloudSecureTech, The Manifest), vendor partner locators for the brands Nexus resells, life-science and Triangle business associations, and the named client results as case studies clients link to. In the 90-day plan.

findings.title: One social link, to a handle that does not match the name
findings.evidence: LinkedIn is the only profile linked from the site, at /company/nexus-networking-technologies/; no YouTube, no Facebook, no Google profile. The Organization schema has no sameAs at all.
findings.cost: Nothing corroborates the entity off-site, which is why the name resolves to other companies.
findings.fix: sameAs to the LinkedIn page, the Glassdoor Morrisville page and the Google Business Profile in the Organization schema; the demonstration rooms and the founder story as short videos on a linked YouTube channel in the plan.

findings.title: Robots and sitemap are healthy; keep AI crawlers open
findings.evidence: robots.txt allows all agents and declares the sitemap; GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended are not blocked. Canonicals point to www. No llms.txt.
findings.cost: No crawl barrier to AI visibility, so the gap is content, schema and authority, not access.
findings.fix: Keep the policy, add an llms.txt, and drop the nine thin URLs from the sitemap at launch.

compare.verdict: Nexus describes eight services well and tells engines nothing about where it is, who it is or what a client asked. Competitors of the same size say Raleigh in the title, carry LocalBusiness or ProfessionalService schema, write 2,500 words on the money page and show a Google rating in the result. The authority gap is real, but it is the second problem. The first is that there is no page to rank.

moves.title: A managed IT page for Raleigh-Durham, LocalBusiness on every page, FAQ everywhere
moves.body: Zero LocalBusiness, zero FAQ and zero Service schema today, against Scarlett and Computerbilities carrying business, offer and address markup on pages of 2,500 words. The build's managed IT page is titled for Raleigh-Durham, the Morrisville office is on every page as a LocalBusiness, and all 21 pages carry FAQPage.

moves.title: Make the entity unambiguous
moves.body: Six of ten brand results are other companies called Nexus. Organization schema gains legalName, the Morrisville address, the phone and sameAs; every title carries Nexus Network Technologies or Raleigh-Durham; LinkedIn, Glassdoor, the chambers and the Google profile carry the same name, address and phone.

moves.title: A Google Business Profile fed by the survey Nexus already runs
moves.body: Every list that assistants read is ordered by Google reviews, and Nexus has none. The post-ticket survey that produces the client comments page gains a second step: a Google review request. Review schema follows when the reviews are real.

moves.title: Get on the lists
moves.body: The top-ten result for best managed IT Raleigh is six directories and lists. Profiles on Cloudtango, Clutch, CloudSecureTech and The Manifest with the same name, address and phone as the site, plus the chambers already linking, put Nexus where the answers come from.

moves.title: Three differentiator pages aimed at local intent, then two guides a month
moves.body: Network as a service, conference room AV and access control each have a Raleigh result with no Nexus in it. The networking, meeting spaces and site intelligence pages in the build carry the local term and a definitional FAQ; the guides answer what is managed it services (1,000 a month) and how much does it cost (720) in the first sentence.

entity.heading: What connects the company across the web
entity.intro: Answer engines corroborate a company across the web before they name it. For Nexus the corroboration points the wrong way: the name is shared with dozens of unrelated companies, and the site does nothing to disambiguate.
tiles: brand review results that belong to other companies named Nexus
social profile linked from the site (LinkedIn), under a handle that differs from the name
sameAs, address or phone in the Organization schema; the WebSite schema reads Just another WordPress site
chambers linking to the site (Triangle East, Charlotte Area, Greensboro), the only real referring domains
found: The Organization schema is Yoast's default: name, URL and logo. Without sameAs, address or phone, an engine cannot tell this Nexus from Nexus Technologies in Glassdoor's index or Nexus Networks LTD in Trustpilot's.
The LinkedIn page exists and is active but its handle is nexus-networking-technologies. The site should link it and the schema should name it, so the two are tied together.

No Google Business Profile appeared in any query. For a company with demonstration rooms in Morrisville, the profile, its photographs, Q&A and reviews are the largest local answer-engine input, and they are not being fed.

The client comments page is real proof from post-ticket surveys and ranks first for the brand reviews query. It has no Review schema and cannot have any until the reviews live on a third-party platform.
The chambers are the only links a human placed. They carry the right name, address and phone and are the model for every listing that follows.
do: Organization schema with legalName, the Morrisville address, telephone, sameAs to LinkedIn and Glassdoor, areaServed for Raleigh, Durham, Cary and Morrisville, and the office as a LocalBusiness with opening hours and coordinates.
Nexus Network Technologies or Raleigh-Durham in every title, and a facts block on the about page: founder, founded, founder-owned, Morrisville, the eight service lines.
Claim and complete the Google Business Profile: hours, services, photographs of the demonstration rooms, Q&A seeded from the site FAQ, and the review request added to the post-ticket survey.
Cloudtango, Clutch, CloudSecureTech and The Manifest profiles with the same name, address and phone; the LinkedIn page linked from the footer.
A YouTube channel with the demonstration rooms and the founder story, linked from the site with VideoObject schema; vendor partner locators for the brands Nexus resells.

today: Semrush US database: 53 organic keywords, 22 visits a month, traffic value 285 dollars a month. Every keyword is the word nexus or a generic phrase; the home page takes 16 of the 22 visits.
Home page title is 93 characters (the tagline), the meta description 250, no og:image. One H1 repeating the tagline.
WordPress 7.1 with Yoast and Divi; three script tags on the home page; the HubSpot tracking script is present; no Google Tag Manager; step forms are custom.
lang is en-US, canonicals point to www.nexusnt.com, and the WebSite schema description is Just another WordPress site.
Schema on every page: Yoast Organization and WebSite, plus BreadcrumbList. No LocalBusiness, FAQPage, Service or Person on any page; no address, phone or sameAs in the Organization record.
One sitemap with 26 URLs: the home page, eight service and industry pages, four person pages, five step-form pages, and the company pages. No posts. One PDF (a 2023 broker article).
robots.txt allows all agents and declares the sitemap; AI crawlers are not blocked. No llms.txt.
The average page scores 35 of 100 on the sixteen checks; all 26 pages score D or F; 10 are under 300 words; 23 of 26 titles carry no city.

hub.heading: Where Nexus stands in search today, and what changes
hub.intro: Measured before we touched anything, so the work can be judged against it. Numbers from Semrush, live search results and nexusnt.com on 8 September 2026.

Best managed it services raleigh nc returns ten results and Nexus is in none. Six of the ten are lists (Cloudtango, Clutch, CloudSecureTech, The Manifest, Petronella, Cortavo), and Nexus is on none of the lists either.
Six of ten results for nexus network technologies reviews are other companies named Nexus. The Organization schema has no address, phone or sameAs to say which Nexus this is.
